brief:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu faces mounting pressure as his political future grows precarious, according to Al Jazeera English. With potential criminal charges and loss of parliamentary support looming, Netanyahu is pursuing strategies that analysts warn could destabilize the country. The calculations underpinning his decisions prioritize personal political survival over institutional stability.

His maneuvering has raised concerns among observers about escalating tensions and potential violence. The high-stakes political contest is unfolding as Netanyahu seeks to maintain power through tactics that risk pushing Israel toward internal disorder. The immediate consequences of his choices remain unclear, though the trajectory suggests deepening institutional strain.
dek: Facing political oblivion, Netanyahu is playing a high-stakes game that could push Israel towards violence and chaos.
title: Netanyahu gambles with Israeli stability amid political crisis
